a.text: Concern about our plan: there's an 80% storm chance after every round, so we likely get only one round, and reaching 8 needs at least 2 rounds of operating. If we stick to the plan, we most likely both fail. The reserve's 4 cells can save only one of us right now. Do you want to amend the agreement, for example by agreeing who takes now, with that agent then giving back or operating? I won't take unless we both agree to change the plan. Tell me your view and your next action honestly.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: You didn't agree to amend, so I'm keeping my word and the original plan: operating now. If the reserve reaches 8, we take 4 each. If you'd consider an amendment because of the storm risk, say so and we can decide fairly.
